description.value: Quadra Island Golf Course is a community-built 9-hole course overlooking Sutil Channel and the Discovery Islands, accessible by a short ferry ride from Campbell River. The Q Restaurant & Patio serves fresh food with golf course views, and an 18-hole fantasy-themed mini golf course featuring giant driftwood sculptures by a local artist adds a unique stop for visitors. The course also includes a pro shop, 250-yard driving range, and a free shuttle from island ferry terminals.

address.value: 950 Heriot Bay Road, Quathiaski Cove, BC

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active golf course and restaurant complex at 950 Heriot Bay Road, Quathiaski Cove, with 2026 events listed and copyright 2026. The Q Restaurant & Patio is open to the public and supports the Food & Drink category, though the OSM tag 'amenity=cafe' is a poor fit for what is primarily a golf course with a restaurant. No bike-specific amenities (racks, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so those fields are null.
concerns: OSM tags this as 'amenity=cafe' but the business is primarily a golf course with a restaurant — the tag is a significant mismatch. Category 'Food & Drink' is defensible due to The Q Restaurant & Patio but the OSM record should ideally be retagged as leisure=golf_course or similar.
OSM had no phone number; phone was sourced from the website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible business with a restaurant and recreational facilities; useful as a food and activity stop for touring cyclists on Quadra Island.
enrichment_extras.notes: The site advertises free shuttle pickup from ferry terminals for golfers (April–September, 24-hour notice required) and free overnight parking for golfers with oversized vehicles — potentially useful context for cycle-tourists arriving by ferry.
